tools.name: LoadBinary
tools.description: Loads an executable into the debugger for a new debugging session. Equivalent to File > Open in the GUI. If a session is already active it is terminated first. The debuggee pauses at the system breakpoint.

filePath.description: Absolute file path of the executable to debug.

tools.name: GetEventLog
tools.description: Returns the last N debugger events (exceptions, breakpoints, DLL loads, thread events, etc.). Keeps the last 64 events in a ring buffer. Use this to see what happened in x64dbg.

count.description: Number of most recent events to return (default: all, max 64).

tools.name: WaitForEvent
tools.description: Blocks until a debugger event fires (breakpoint hit, paused, resumed, exception, session start/stop) or timeout. Returns all events that occurred. Use this to monitor debugger state changes in real-time over HTTP — call it after 'run' or while waiting for the user to interact with the debugger.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds (default 30000, max 120000).

tools.name: WaitForPause
tools.description: Blocks until the debuggee stops running (hits a breakpoint, exception, or exits). Returns the reason for the pause and the current address. Use after 'run' to wait for the target to break.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Resumes execution and waits for the target to pause (breakpoint, exception, or exit). Blocks until a pause event occurs or timeout. Use timeoutMs to control how long to wait (default 120s). Always returns the reason for the pause and current state.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for target to pause after resuming (default 300000ms = 5 minutes, max 600000ms = 10 minutes). The tool blocks until a breakpoint/exception fires or timeout.

tools.name: SetBreakpoint
tools.description: Sets a software execution breakpoint (INT3) at an address or API symbol.

target.description: Hex address or API symbol to break on.

tools.name: DeleteBreakpoint
tools.description: Removes a breakpoint at an address or API symbol.

target.description: Hex address or API symbol of the breakpoint to remove.

tools.name: ListBreakpoints
tools.description: Lists all active breakpoints (software, hardware, and memory).

tools.name: SetHardwareBreakpoint
tools.description: Sets a hardware breakpoint using debug registers (DR0-DR3). Supports read, write, and execute types.

tools.name: SetMemoryBreakpoint
tools.description: Sets a memory breakpoint at an address. Triggers when memory is accessed (read/write/execute). Uses guard pages — slower than hardware breakpoints but no DR register limit.

type.description: Type: r (read/access), w (write), x (execute). Default: access (any).

singleshoot.description: If true, breakpoint is removed after first hit (default false).

tools.name: RunToAddress
tools.description: Sets a temporary breakpoint at the target address, resumes execution, and waits for the debuggee to hit it.

tools.name: SetConditionalBreakpoint
tools.description: Sets a breakpoint with a condition expression and optional log text.

tools.name: EnableBreakpoint
tools.description: Enables a breakpoint at a given address.

tools.name: DisableBreakpoint
tools.description: Disables a breakpoint at a given address without deleting it.

tools.name: ToggleBreakpoint
tools.description: Toggles a breakpoint between enabled and disabled.

tools.name: DeleteAllBreakpoints
tools.description: Removes all breakpoints (normal, hardware, and memory).

tools.name: ResetHitCount
tools.description: Resets the hit counter of a breakpoint at the given address to zero.

tools.name: SetExceptionBreakpoint
tools.description: Controls how an exception code is handled: break into debugger or pass to application. Use this to ignore Delphi (0EEDFADE), C++ (E06D7363), or other framework exceptions during startup, or to break on specific exceptions like ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION (C000001D).

exceptionCode.description: Exception code in hex (e.g. C000001D, 0EEDFADE, E06D7363).

action.description: break = break into debugger, ignore = pass to application (default break).

tools.name: DeleteExceptionBreakpoint
tools.description: Removes an exception breakpoint, restoring default handling for that exception code.

exceptionCode.description: Exception code in hex to delete.

tools.name: SetBreakpointCommand
tools.description: Sets an x64dbg command to execute when a breakpoint at the given address is hit. Use for logging breakpoints (e.g., 'log {x:eax}' to log register values on hit).

command.description: x64dbg command to run on hit (e.g. 'log {x:eax}', 'msg {utf8@[esp+4]}').

tools.name: SetBreakpointFastResume
tools.description: Makes a breakpoint auto-resume after hit without pausing. Combined with SetBreakpointCommand, creates logging breakpoints that record state at thousands of call sites without stopping.

enable.description: true to enable fast resume, false to disable.

tools.name: SaveDatabase
tools.description: Saves the x64dbg database (labels, comments, breakpoints, analysis) for the current module. Persists your work across sessions.
